items.title: 244 content elements
items.content: Ten groups, from heroes to footers. Each element has a backend preview and demo content, so you can start building pages at once.

items.title: 62 Fluid 5 components
items.content: 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms, such as d:atom.button and d:layout.section. They keep the markup consistent, including in elements you build yourself.

items.title: 15 theme presets
items.content: Five shadcn/ui presets and ten house designs, each with dark mode and checked contrast. Switch the whole site or one part of it, without a rebuild.
